Headline: Loop "L" Line Delays
ShortDescription: Loop "L" trains are running with residual delays following an earlier mechanical problem at LaSalle/Van Buren. Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Loop "L"  trains are running with residual delays following an earlier mechanical problem at LaSalle/Van Buren. 

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.

Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.
